name: Flatten Table
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Fixes a table crash on a link target with a bare percent sign.
Shows script links from properties as plain text.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A table no longer crashes when a link contains a bare percent sign.
Links in properties that start with javascript: or data: now show as plain text.
tip: Hold Shift and click column headers to sort by several columns at once.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Flatten Table is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
